The namespace must correspond to an identity source created in Admin Console and must be in the form of `identitysources/{identity_source}`.

id.description: The ID of the entity. For Google-managed entities, the `id` should be the email address of an existing group or user. For external-identity-mapped entities, the `id` must be a string conforming to the Identity Source's requirements. Must be unique within a `namespace`.

EntityKey.description: A unique identifier for an entity in the Cloud Identity Groups API. An entity can represent either a group with an optional `namespace` or a user without a `namespace`.
